items.claim: CurvedLabel shows Latin text backwards under `dir="rtl"` with no bidi engine
useRunScroll keeps a stale offset after its range shrinks, so focus and glide go wrong
useItemLengths' ResizeObserver never unobserves items that left
LensRim lab crashes on saved marks that are not an array
TrackGeometry lab accepts saved handles whose y is not a number
CurvedLabel's `offset` does nothing for a label that fits its track
Bent run text is misplaced under a rotated ancestor when the row does not scroll
items.note: `RunBand` now always renders its svg so the text has a frame to map through; the band path is still drawn only while the row scrolls.

items.claim: LensRim lab's marks drift off their spot when Size changes
items.note: Marks are now stored as shares of the picture, under a new storage key (`v2`).

items.claim: InputTrace never sets "claimed" on a coalesced pointermove line
A sideways wheel scrolls a right-to-left-reading run backwards
Whole-circle drag across the seam throws the scroll to one end
Slot hosts' nested items never get `touch-action: none`
`useRunText` maps client points by bounding-box scale, wrong under a rotated ancestor
items.note: It now maps through the row's band with `boxPoint`. `turnOf` was not a defect: the copy is laid in the root's frame, so the item's own transform is the right turn.

items.claim: `useItemLengths` keeps every key it has ever seen
items.note: plus e1f45493eb (an effect dependency that lint flagged)

items.claim: LensRim lab saves an uncapped list of marks
items.note: It now keeps the last 100. The lab isn't shipped, so no changeset.
